# Tech OA Questions

Online assessment (OA) questions candidates reported at tech companies, one folder per company.

**Snapshot as of 2026-11-26: 835 OA questions from 110 companies.**

The question pages are on [TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io).

## How to use

- Pick a company in the table below. Its folder has `README.md` (the questions as a table, newest first) and `oa.csv` (the same rows as data).
- Every row in one file: [data/questions.csv](data/questions.csv) and [data/questions.jsonl](data/questions.jsonl).
- Phone screen, onsite and take-home questions are in the sibling repository [Tech-Interview-Questions](https://github.com/kevin-2023-code/Tech-Interview-Questions).

## Columns

- **Title**: the question title, linked to its page.
- **Format**: Coding, SQL, OOD / LLD, System design, AI coding, or Behavioral / concept.
- **Difficulty**: Easy, Medium or Hard. Empty for formats that have no difficulty.
- **Level**: the levels it was reported at (Intern, New grad, Mid, Senior, Staff+, Manager).
- **Role**: the role it was reported for.
- **Last Reported**: the month of the most recent report, `YYYY-MM`. Empty when unknown.
- **Link**: the question page (CSV only; in the tables the title is the link).

A question is listed when the catalog tags it with the OA round. The tag belongs to the question, so a question reported at several companies is listed under each of them. Only metadata is published here: no statements and no solutions.
